nt2e01.title: Things that make sense: cold nights
nt2e01.caption: Cold nights have a system: blankets, soup, and one Capricorn carrying a spare scarf just in case. Who in your life always has the extra layer?

nt2e02.title: Things that make sense: texting
nt2e02.caption: A proofread "on my way.", three voice notes in a row, and a "home safe?" at 11 PM that gets a yes in two seconds. Which texter are you?

nt2e04.title: Things that make sense: party season
nt2e04.caption: Party season, sorted: Aries opens the dance floor, Gemini knows every name by nine, and Capricorn has both coats ready the second you say you're tired.

nt2e05.title: Things that make sense: love languages
nt2e05.caption: Taurus pushes the biggest snack your way. Aries wins the race to the car, then holds the door. Virgo fixes the squeaky door and never mentions it. Which one have you dated?

nt2e06.title: Unpopular opinion: plans are romantic
nt2e06.caption: Capricorn said planning a date is romantic and the crowd gasped. Then Sagittarius pulled out a colour-coded planner. Team spontaneous or team Saturday at seven?

nt2e07.title: Unpopular opinion: "I'm not sure yet"
nt2e07.caption: Libra climbed onto a crate to defend "I'm not sure yet" and somehow Taurus ended up in tears. An honest maybe beats a rushed yes.
